measurementRules.rule: Measure accepted gross mass minus measured can/closure/cap/carton tare in the same configuration; retain whole contents including actual impurities and headspace components. Nominal fill is not a count-to-mass conversion.

Keep nominal100% separate from measured analytical fractions and their wet/dry or liquid/vapor bases. No pure-EO equivalent denominator, sum-of-known-impurities closure of unknowns, or default carrier mass.

measurementRules.applies_to: nitrogen; oxygen_uptake; eo_air; co2_air; co_air; water_air; nitrogen_air
measurementRules.rule: Convert volume only with measured state/composition and compatible method; preserve raw standard/actual and dry/wet records. Gas rate integrates once; phase change is not a new chemical source.
Retain actual metered electrical demand including preheat, ventilation and compressors. Heat recovery internal to the oxidizer is not another imported heat or an export credit.

Preserve actual whole gas-mixture volume and liquid-mixture mass separately with phase/composition/T/P/wet-dry/actual-standard basis; conversion to actual native provider units needs an evidenced compatible mapping, never a pure-EO or gas-density default.

Measure drive air and respirator breathing air separately, with actual/standard and dry/wet volume, T/P, humidity, composition, actual grade and paired provider reference conditions. No pressure/flow/grade/density default; integrate rates once and preserve physical totals separately from compatible provider demand.

calculationRules.rule: Q is the independent sum of unique first-accepted net whole-content masses. Lock original cohorts; no gross-loop or nominal-can-count substitution.
Reconcile Q to disjoint original-basis retained external delivery, all on-site accepted states, irreversible loss and terminal disposition. Track additions separately.

Divide only the evidenced attributable exchange/service amount by the same independent positive Q; old-cohort later service uses original positive Q0. Preserve complete raw physical totals separately; unknown basis or causal share remains unresolved.

calculationRules.applies_to: can_body; crimp_closure; protective_cap; carton; delivered_can_body; delivered_closure; delivered_cap; delivered_carton
calculationRules.rule: For each physical article reconcile opening plus actual receipts and returns against closing stocks, installed/delivered transfers and actual scrap once; net contents exclude all tare.

calculationRules.applies_to: bulk_cylinder; returned_cylinder; nitrogen_cylinder; returned_nitrogen_cylinder; catalyst_cell; inlet_filter; filler_seal
calculationRules.rule: Reconcile the full physical fleet and residual contents independently of compatible disjoint provider/service demands. No invented item mass/lifetime and no new manufacturing at every use.

calculationRules.applies_to: nitrogen; oxygen_uptake; eo_air; co2_air; co_air; water_air; nitrogen_air
calculationRules.rule: Integrate actual compatible concentration and flow once; retain gas-state and background corrections, phase stocks and elemental balances. Complete oxidation is a reaction check, not an assumed conversion/factor.
Full receiver Qt is one physical event; nested components add no exports. Sum compatible non-overlapping cohort treatment demands to actual provider demand, with each demand using original Q/Q0.

For each purpose reconcile complete raw air supply, storage/header/hose changes, actual use, leaks and all final exhaust/other exits on compatible measured state and composition. Use and exhaust are successive internal handoffs that cancel on consolidation, not additional external sinks. Volumes at different conditions are not additive without an evidenced state conversion. Integrate a measured rate once; do not multiply an integrated volume by time. Preserve separate raw gross volume and compatible producer demand; only evidenced disjoint cohort demand is passed to normalize once. Qualified aggregate versus expanded producer utility/conditioning/waste histories are alternatives. Track actual air exhaust into the GasHouse/abator mixture and other real exits, without counting unchanged carrier nitrogen/oxygen/water as additional elementary emissions.

measurementRules.rule: 以同一配置验收毛重减去测得罐体、卷封盖、保护盖及纸箱皮重；保留含实际杂质和顶空组分的完整内容物，名义装量不是件数到质量的换算。
将名义100%与测得分析分数及其干湿基、气液基区分，不采用纯环氧乙烷当量分母，不以已知杂质之和闭合未知量，不假定载气质量。

measurementRules.applies_to: nitrogen; oxygen_uptake; eo_air; co2_air; co_air; water_air; nitrogen_air
measurementRules.rule: 仅依据测得状态、组成及兼容方法转换体积，保留原始标准或实际体积及干湿基；气体速率只积分一次，相变不成为新化学来源。
保留含预热、通风及压缩机的实际计量电量；氧化器内部回热不是另一项导入热量或外供抵扣。
分别保留实际整体气体混合物体积及液体混合物质量，连同相态组成温压干湿基实际标准基；换算至实际原生供应商单位必须具有有据兼容映射，不采用纯环氧乙烷或气体密度默认值。
分别测量驱动空气和呼吸器供气，记录实际标准和干湿基体积、温压、湿度、组成、实际等级及配对供应商参考条件。不采用压力流量等级密度默认值；速率只积分一次，实物总量另行保留，区别于兼容供应商需求。

calculationRules.rule: Q为独立汇总的唯一首次验收完整内容物净质量，锁定原批群，不以累计循环或名义罐数替代。
将Q核对至原口径互斥外部留存交付、所有现场验收状态、不可逆损失和最终去向，补料另行跟踪。
仅将有据归属交换或服务数量除以同一独立正Q；旧批群后续服务使用原正Q0，完整原始实物总量另存，未知基准或因果份额保持未解决。

calculationRules.rule: 逐一将物件期初加实际接收和退回，核对至期末存量、装配交付及实际报废一次，内容物净质量排除全部皮重。

calculationRules.applies_to: bulk_cylinder; returned_cylinder; nitrogen_cylinder; returned_nitrogen_cylinder; catalyst_cell; inlet_filter; filler_seal
calculationRules.rule: 完整实物资产群及残余内容物独立于兼容互斥供应商服务需求核对，不虚构单件质量寿命，不在每次使用时计新制造。

calculationRules.applies_to: nitrogen; oxygen_uptake; eo_air; co2_air; co_air; water_air; nitrogen_air
calculationRules.rule: 实际兼容浓度和流量只积分一次，保留气体状态背景校正、相态存量及元素平衡，完全氧化仅作反应核对，不是假定转化率或因子。
完整接收量Qt是一个实物事件，嵌套组分不增加外运；将兼容不重叠批群处理需求汇总至实际供应商需求，各需求采用原Q或Q0。

逐一用途按兼容实测状态组成核对完整原始供气、储气总管软管变化、实际使用、泄漏及全部最终排气其他出口。使用和排气是相继内部交接，合并时抵消，不是新增外部去向。不同条件体积不得在缺少有据状态转换时相加。测得速率只积分一次，已积分体积不再乘时间。原始总气量与兼容生产者需求分账，仅将有据互斥批群需求交由normalize归一化一次。合格汇总与展开生产者的公用工程调理废物历史为替代表示。跟踪实际排气进入GasHouse治理器混合气及其他真实出口，不将未变化的载气氮氧水另计基本排放。
